messages.author: EMP-N-004
messages.text: Typhoon warning for Shenzhen (Yantian). Port authority says PORT-N-CNSZX closes tonight, probably five to seven days.

messages.author: EMP-N-005
messages.text: We have open orders on lanes out of Shenzhen (Yantian). I'm checking alternate routing through Hong Kong.

messages.author: EMP-N-004
messages.text: Rerouting the larger customer orders through Hong Kong and Ningbo-Zhoushan. Adds two to four days. This is our standard port closure play.

messages.author: EMP-N-001
messages.text: Flowers-Gomez [SYNTH] just confirmed their plant is shut too. Battery packs will be the bottleneck.
